name: jobhunter
postCreateCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/typst.tar.xz https://github.com/typst/typst/releases/download/v0.13.1/typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz && echo '7d214bfeffc2e585dc422d1a09d2b144969421281e8c7f5d784b65fc69b5673f  /tmp/typst.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c - && sudo tar -xf /tmp/typst.tar.xz -C /opt && sudo ln -sf /opt/typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/typst /usr/local/bin/typst && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils
